藏经石室，墨香沉滞。

木质书架老旧腐朽，泛黄卷宗层层堆叠，纸面爬满暗色霉斑，数十年阴冷潮湿的地底环境，让每一卷典籍都带着陈旧腐朽的岁月味道。众人各司其职，指尖翻动秘卷，小心翼翼将东瀛邪派禁术典籍、蛊术图谱、咒文原稿逐一收拢打包，纸张摩擦的细微声响，在死寂密闭的石室之中格外清晰。

林佳手持便携高清摄像仪，镜头平稳扫过墙面悬挂的古老咒图，画面定格、留存归档。咒图纹路诡异扭曲，密密麻麻勾勒出地脉侵染、生魂献祭、式神炼煞的完整流程，图中山脉轮廓分明是长白山全貌，标注的血色节点，皆是近些年关外离奇死人、阴煞泛滥的凶地。

“全部记录完毕。”林佳压低声音，指尖快速操作仪器，“这些卷宗详细记载了东瀛三派近五十年的布局脉络，从最早渗透关外村镇、暗中抓捕流民饲蛊炼煞，到后期篡改山巅地脉、修建龙脉祭坛，每一步谋划都清晰在册。甚至还有下一阶段的侵脉方案，只是被我们提前打断，未能施行。”

杨瑞捧着一卷黑色皮质封皮的孤本，指尖摩挲冰凉粗糙的皮面，神色凝重：“这是阴阳寮高层手写密录，里面提到山巅献祭大阵只是前置试炼，目的是撬动长白山龙脉表层龙气，用来喂养一件封印在地底的邪器。邪器未成，他们绝不会轻易放弃关外。”

钱丹驻足蛊术典籍专区，雪白指尖轻轻拂过一卷虫蛀残破的蛊卷，眸色发冷：“九菊一派真正的本命凶蛊并非山巅蛊王，此处卷宗记载，地底暗河深处培育着一只千年寒蛊母虫，以地脉阴气、龙脉浊气常年喂养，隐匿数十年从不现世，是九菊压箱底的蛊道底牌。”

众人低声交谈，整理典籍的动作不曾停歇。谁都清楚，这批典籍价值极高，既是邪派罪证，也是749局推演后续风险、防范域外邪祟的关键依据，绝不能遗漏半分。

就在此时，石室最内侧，一面靠墙的实木书架突然微微震颤。

震颤幅度极轻，初听如同地底暗流涌动、岩石轻微挤压，混杂在众人动作声响之中，极易被忽略。可胡九郎天眼通透，神识铺展整间石室，瞬间捕捉到这一丝异样震动。

“停手。”

清冷二字落下，声音不高，却带着不容置疑的威严。所有人动作骤然停滞，下意识收敛气息，周身灵气悄然运转，瞬间进入戒备临战状态。

幽暗密闭的藏经石室，温度骤然骤降。

原本只是阴冷潮湿的空气，此刻化作刺骨寒冽，顺着衣领、袖口钻入侵体，皮肉发麻，神魂发凉。空气中淡淡的墨香、腐朽纸味，被一股厚重浑浊、带着陈年血腥与死寂的阴冷气息强行覆盖。

那股气息古老、沉厚、阴毒，带着活人久居阴地、常年以邪术滋养自身的腐朽质感，绝非普通凶蛊、残煞、低级式神所能拥有。

In the stone room where the scriptures are stored, the fragrance of ink lingers.

The wooden bookshelves are old and decaying, and the yellowed volumes are stacked layer by layer. The paper is covered with dark mold spots. The decades of cold and damp underground environment give each volume of classics an old and decaying flavor.Everyone performed their duties, flipping through the secret scrolls with their fingertips, carefully gathering and packaging the Japanese evil sect's forbidden magic books, Gu magic atlas, and mantra manuscripts one by one. The subtle sound of the paper rubbing against each other was particularly clear in the dead silence and airtight stone chamber.

Lin Jia held a portable high-definition camera, and the lens steadily scanned the ancient mantras hanging on the wall, freezing the picture and keeping it in the archives.The lines of the curse map are weird and twisted, densely outlining the complete process of earth vein infestation, soul sacrifice, and shikigami refining evil. The mountains in the map are clearly outlined, showing the entire Changbai Mountain. The bloody nodes marked are all dangerous places outside the customs where strange deaths have occurred and evil spirits have been rampant in recent years.

"All records have been recorded." Lin Jia lowered her voice and quickly operated the instrument with her fingertips. "These files record in detail the layout of the three Japanese sects in the past fifty years. From the earliest infiltration of villages and towns outside the pass, secretly arresting refugees to feed Gu and refine evil spirits, to the later tampering with the mountain top earth veins and building dragon vein altars, every step of the plan is clearly recorded. There is even a plan to invade the veins in the next stage, but we interrupted it in advance and failed to implement it."

Yang Rui held an isolated volume with a black leather cover and rubbed the cold, rough leather with his fingertips. His expression was solemn: "This is a secret handwritten note by the top executives of Yin Yang Lao. It mentions that the mountain top sacrifice array is just a preliminary trial. The purpose is to pry the dragon energy on the surface of Changbai Mountain's dragon veins and use it to feed an evil weapon sealed underground. Before the evil weapon is completed, they will never give up easily."

Qian Dan stopped at the Gu book section, and his snow-white fingertips gently brushed a torn Gu scroll with cold eyes: "The real evil Gu of the Jiuju sect is not the Gu king on the top of the mountain. The files here record that a thousand-year cold Gu mother is cultivated deep in the underground river. It is fed by the Yin Qi of the earth veins and the turbid Qi of the dragon veins all the year round. It has been hidden for decades and never appeared. It is the secret card of the Gu Dao at the bottom of Jiuju's pressure box."

Everyone was chatting in low voices, and the action of sorting out the classics never stopped.Everyone knows that this batch of classics is of extremely high value. It is not only evidence of the evil sect's crimes, but also a key basis for Bureau 749 to deduce subsequent risks and prevent evil spirits from outside the territory. Not even a single cent can be missed.

At this moment, at the innermost side of the stone room, a solid wood bookshelf against the wall suddenly trembled slightly.

The tremors were extremely light in amplitude. At first they sounded like undercurrents surging underground and rocks squeezing slightly. They were mixed in with the sounds of everyone's movements and were easily ignored.But Hu Jiulang's eyes were clear, his consciousness spread throughout the stone room, and he instantly caught this strange vibration.

"Stop."

The word "cold" fell, and the voice was not high, but it carried an unquestionable majesty.Everyone's movements suddenly stopped, and they subconsciously restrained their aura. The spiritual energy around their bodies circulated quietly, and they instantly entered a state of alert for battle.

In the dark and airtight Buddhist scriptures stone chamber, the temperature suddenly dropped.

The air that was originally just cold and humid turned into biting coldness, penetrating into the body along the collar and cuffs, making the skin and flesh numb and the soul chilling.The faint scent of ink and decaying paper in the air was forcibly covered by a thick, turbid, cold breath of old blood and death.

That aura is ancient, thick, and sinister, with the decaying texture of a living person who has lived in the underworld for a long time and nourished himself with evil magic all the year round. It is definitely not something that ordinary vicious Gu, residual evil spirits, and low-level shikigami can have.
